name: Huanying Variant Branches
body: Goal: prepare 3 to 5 meaningful creative directions from the selected subgraph. Each branch should state its creative difference, source nodes, and risk. Default to prepare-only branches and notes; do not auto-generate paid outputs unless the user asks and policy allows it. Use current selection first. If no clear source exists, ask for clarification instead of duplicating the whole canvas.
compactBody: 变体分支：基于选区做3-5个真实差异方向，说明差异/风险；默认只准备和排版，不自动生成。
qualityRubric: Branches differ in concept, style, camera, or mood.
Each branch can be understood without opening hidden metadata.
decisionGuide: Layout branches so comparison is easy.
antiPatterns: Making tiny wording changes but calling them variants.
Auto-generating paid results while the user only asked for directions.
